Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XXII OF 2017
ACT XXII OF 2017
PUNJAB EHTRAM-E-RAMAZAN
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Ehtram-e-Ramazan
Ordinance, 1981
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
8th November, 2017]
No. PAP/Legis-2(172)/2017/1674, dated 8.11.2017.---The
Punjab Ehtram-e-Ramazan (Amendment) Bill 2017, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on October 25, 2017, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on October 30, 2017, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the Ehtram-e-Ramazan Ordinance, 1981 (XXIII of
1981), in its application to Province of the Punjab, for purposes of updating
and rationalizing the existing provisions and for ancillary matters.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short title,
extent and commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the
Punjab Ehtram-e-Ramazan (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
